nTrialsPerRun.description: How many trials should be run before the forced break.

nRunsPerBlock.description: How many runs should be run befor the block break.

nBlocks.description: The maximal number of blocks to be run.

dotCoherenceRing.description: Coherence of dots in the peripheral patches.

circleRadius.description: The radius of the central dot patch, in degrees of visual angle.

circleMaskRadius.description: The proportion of the circle area that will be masked and used for the response display.

circleMaskSpan.description: The span of the mask in pi radians (0-2), 0 = no mask, 2 = full circle.

circleNDots.description: The number of dots presented in the circle

ringRadius.description: The radius of the outer rings, in degrees of visual angle.

ringMaskRadius.description: The proportion of the ring area that will be masked and used for the central circle display.

ringMaskSpan.description: The span of the mask in pi radians (0-2), 0 = no mask, 2 =full circle.

dotSize.description: The diameter of individual dots, in degrees of visual angle.

dotSpeed.description: Dot speed in degrees of visual angle per second

dotCoherenceCircle.description: The coherence of dot motion, expressed as kappa parameter of the von Mises distribution.

nMotionDirections.description: The number of possible motion directions.

soundPitch.description: The note used for the sound stimuli.

soundOctaveRespOn.description: The octave of the sound after the response.

soundOctaveRespOff.description: The octave of the sound after the response deadline.

textHeight.description: The height of letters, in degrees of visual angle.

textWidth.description: The width of one line of text, after which the new line starts.

textPosition.description: The x and y coordinates where the text should be presented, in degrees of visual angle.

description: The period during which coherent motion is presented in the central patch, in seconds
This can be increased to 2.0 s, but then the response deadline should be decreased for 1 s.
That way, the trial duration will remain 6 s.

peripheralSignalDuration.description: The period during which the motion signal is presented in peripheral patches, in seconds.

description: The time interval after signal offset during which participants should respond, in seconds.
The total time to respond is actually signalDuration + responseDeadline.
The centralSignalDuration can be increased from 1 s to 2 s, but then subtract 1 s from responseDeadline.
That way, the trial duration will remain 6 s.

feedbackDuration.description: The period during which response feedback is presented, in seconds.

breakDuration.description: The duration of the forced break, in seconds.

padHeight.description: The height (y-axis) of the response pad, in cm
